The Taurus PT-25 is a compact, semi-automatic pistol manufactured by Taurus International, designed primarily for concealed carry and personal defense. Chambered in .25 ACP, the PT-25 features a unique tip-up barrel design, allowing easy chamber loading without slide manipulation. It operates on a simple blowback system and offers a double-action-only (DAO) trigger mechanism. With a capacity of 9 rounds, the PT-25 combines small size with ease of use, appealing to shooters looking for a lightweight and easily concealable backup firearm.

The Taurus PT-22 is a compact, semi-automatic pistol designed for concealed carry and recreational shooting. Chambered in .22 Long Rifle (LR), the PT-22 shares the same tip-up barrel design as its .25 ACP counterpart, the PT-25, allowing for easy loading and chamber inspection without needing to rack the slide. It operates on a simple blowback action and typically features a double-action-only (DAO) trigger system. With a magazine capacity of 8 rounds, the PT-22 is known for its lightweight build, low recoil, and ease of use, making it popular among beginners and those seeking a small, easily concealable handgun.
